name: Wilmer Jesus Colmenares-Gonzalez
crime: Convicted: DALLAS – United States Attorney Ryan Raybould today announced that Wilmer Jesus Colmenares-Gonzalez, a 27-year-old illegal alien from Venezuela who illegally entered the United States in 2023 and later led a violent kidnapping and home invasion crew in Dallas, was sentenced to 20 years in federal prison for kidnapping a victim during a brutal home invasion robbery.

name: Victor Hugo Garcia-Dominguez
crime: Convicted: LAS VEGAS – An illegal alien from Mexico was sentenced today by United States District Judge Cristina D. Silva to 18 months in prison to be followed by three years of supervised release for illegally reentering the United States after having been removed from the country on two prior occasions. According to court documents and statements made during court proceedings, Victor Hugo Garcia-Dominguez was found in the United States by immigration officials on September 10, 2024, after Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department arrested him for Attempted Burglary of a Motor Vehicle.

name: Axel Bladimir Montejo Saenz
crime: Charged: SAN DIEGO – Alleged Guatemalan drug kingpin Axel Bladimir Montejo Saenz, aka “Mosh,” aka “Kraken,” who is accused of running a massive cocaine trafficking operation as a leader of a transnational criminal organization with ties to narcoterrorist cartels has been arrested in San Diego by members of the Homeland Security Task Force (HSTF). Montejo Saenz is charged in a November 1, 2018 indictment with Conspiracy to Distribute Cocaine Intended for Unlawful Importation and Conspiracy to Distribute Cocaine on Board a Vessel.

name: Ada Evila Serrano Nuñez
crime: Charged: ATLANTA – In the first-ever prosecution under the U.S. Foreign Extortion Prevention Act, Ada Evila Serrano Nuñez, a consul general of Honduras from July 2022 through March 2026, has been arrested for allegedly using her former position to demand cash bribes to allow Honduran citizens to access and obtain official government services from the Consulate in Atlanta. On September 1, 2026, a grand jury in Atlanta returned an indictment charging Ada Evila Serrano Nuñez, 72, of Honduras, with demanding bribes, conspiring to demand bribes, and conspiring to launder money.
